[[ ## rule ## ]]
A term is one term when both surface forms denote the same target; a term is two terms when they denote distinct concepts, even if one is a subtype or specialization of the other; an article such as “the” does not separate terms; and hyphenated or joined compounds are treated as one term when they function as a single named concept.

[[ ## decision ## ]]
two-terms
